overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate but contained some duplicates and minor formatting issues. The paper clearly focuses on chess commentary generation and evaluation, with both automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, GCC-Eval) and human/LLM evaluations. GCC-Eval is their proposed LLM-based evaluation method that incorporates expert model guidance. Human evaluation was well-documented with specific criteria and scales.
